text: おれなんか　カラカラ　みつけた　もんね！

structure.jp: カラカラ　みつけた

patterns.name: 〜もん
patterns.explanation: もん is a short form of もの put at the end to state your case in a childish, boasting way; with ね it sounds like 'so there!'. みつけた　もんね = 'I found one, so there!'

patterns.name: 〜なんか
patterns.explanation: なんか after a word picks it out as an example, here to brag: 'take me, for instance'. おれなんか = 'me, I'.
